WAVE_1.wave_name: WAVE_1: Foundational Corrections (Schema, Security, Authority, Idempotency & Split Tender)
WAVE_1.rationale: Establishes foundational database schema, tenant/branch security boundaries, server authority, and mandatory financial account constraints before higher-level modules execute.

WAVE_2.wave_name: WAVE_2: Workflow Corrections (Inventory, AR Immutability, Reversals & Ledger Integrity)
WAVE_2.rationale: Enforces strict ledger immutability on posted sales, prevents inventory deficits during purchase cancellation, and integrates stock adjustment asset accounting.

WAVE_3.wave_name: WAVE_3: Procurement & Extended Backend (Landed Cost, Inter-Branch, Supplier Returns & Payroll HR)
WAVE_3.rationale: Introduces complete Supplier Return debit note workflow, landed cost proration, inter-branch in-transit clearing states, and staff payroll compensation schema.

WAVE_4.wave_name: WAVE_4: UI, Offline, Sync, Hardware & Extended Fields (Offline POS, Print, Pairing, UI Safety & Master Fields)
WAVE_4.rationale: Refines offline POS checkout, fixes print-before-commit sequence, validates LAN pairing IP boundaries, adds destructive confirmation modals, and persists customer secondary phone & monthly budgets.
